downstream_impact: The prepared training builder re-detected exact tactics from the canonical board and overwrote these labels before training. The frozen model training rows were therefore expected to be unaffected; their SHA-256 will be checked after regeneration.
issue: DAgger exact tactical action indices were stored in source-board orientation while the state was D4-canonicalized.
model_and_dev_action: The pre-correction candidates, source annotations, training outputs, and 80 blind games are preserved under results/precorrection and are exploratory only. After fixing canonical tactical coordinates, annotation was rerun, a new deterministic opening schedule was frozen, and the final F1/F2 blind evaluation ran once on 20 fresh paired opening groups.
post_fix_reason_hash_changed: The ordinary C/E5 200ms labels can vary slightly when regenerated under wall-clock cutoffs; the canonical tactic correction also caused the entire labeling pass to rerun. The exact source annotations are preserved and their SHA is recorded.
